description: Record each prompt and answer in Prompt Analyzer. Runs integrations/hook.py with the first working Python 3.9+ (python3, python, py) and always exits 0, so a missing Python or a stopped server never blocks the prompt.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/integrations/hook.py" claude; done; exit 0
